k:釈.mnemonic: A teacher sifts (釆) a tangled idea, shaking out the chaff, and plants a little flag (尸) on each point that is left so the class can follow. Explanation.
k:釈.hint: Flags planted on the sifted points.

k:描.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) hold a pencil and trace the flowers (艹) growing along the edge of the rice field (田), one quick line after another. Sketch (compose, draw, paint).
k:描.hint: Pencil tracing flowers by the paddy.

k:症.mnemonic: A doctor at the sickbed (疒) ticks off a list: fever, cough, rash. Only when every sign is noted can she name the correct (正) illness. Symptoms (illness).

k:敵.mnemonic: By happenstance (故) two rivals are booked for the same podium (啇) at the same hour. They glare across it, each wanting the other gone. Enemy (foe, opponent).

k:岐.mnemonic: On the mountain (山) the trail splits in two, and a signpost propped on a support (支) points one arm each way. Left or right? Branch off (fork in road, scene, arena).
k:岐.hint: Signpost where the mountain trail splits.

k:巡.mnemonic: A guard walks the path (辶) that loops beside the stream (巛), round and round the camp all night, as steadily as the water flows. Patrol (go around, circumference).

k:敷.mnemonic: Release (放) ten (十) bundles of straw over the rice field (田) and rake them flat until the whole field is covered like a mat. Spread (pave, sit, promulgate).
k:敷.hint: Straw raked flat over a field.

k:邦.mnemonic: On the left a tall staff with three crossbars, like a boundary post hung with banners. On the right a walled town. Post and town together say: this land is ours. Home country (country, Japan, nation).
k:邦.hint: Boundary post beside a walled town.

k:祖.mnemonic: At the altar (礻) stands a stack of memorial tablets: grandfather, and moreover (且) his father, and moreover his father before him, shelf upon shelf. Ancestor (pioneer, founder).
k:祖.hint: Shelves of tablets at the altar.

k:殿.mnemonic: A great hall with a flag (尸) on the roof, where guards stand together (共), each with a weapon (殳), and bow as the lord of the house walks by. Address him politely. Mr. (hall, mansion, palace).
k:殿.hint: Guards bowing in the lord's hall.

k:携.mnemonic: A farmer sets off for market with a turkey (隹) tucked under one arm and a small scythe (乃) hooked on his fingers (扌). Everything he needs goes with him. Portable (carry in hand, armed with, bring along).
k:携.hint: Turkey under arm, scythe in hand.

k:漢.mnemonic: A great yellow river, a tsunami (氵) of silt, runs under heaven (天) past banks of flowers (艹) to its wide mouth (口): the heartland of the Han people. Sino- (China).

k:偽.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who says 'I do (為) it all for you' while doing it all for himself. What he says and what he does never match. Falsehood (lie, deceive, pretend).
k:偽.hint: Leader's words don't match his deeds.

k:寝.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) you sweep a plank (爿) clean with a broom (ヨ), rest your forehead (冖) on it, and let your tired hand drop also (又). Time to stretch out. Lie down (sleep, rest, bed).
k:寝.hint: Forehead resting on a swept plank.

k:幼.mnemonic: Tiny (幺) power (力): a little fist that can barely grip your finger. It is the age when all strength is still very small. Infancy (childhood).
k:幼.hint: A little fist gripping a finger.

k:瀬.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of white water races over the rocks. To cross, you must trust (頼) the guide's rope and step exactly where he steps on the shallow stones. Rapids (current, torrent, shallows).
k:瀬.hint: Crossing white water on a rope.

k:扱.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) reach out (及), seize a bundle of rice stalks and drag it through the comb so that the grains strip off into the basket. Thresh (handle, entertain, strip).

k:壊.mnemonic: The old wall of soil (土) must come down: ten (十) workers throw a net (罒) over it and heave, and dust settles on every garment (衣) as it collapses. Demolition (break, destroy).
k:壊.hint: Ten workers pulling a wall down.

k:締.mnemonic: The sovereign (帝) is being dressed. Servants pull the thread (糸) of his sash until the knot is snug and the robe cannot slip. Tighten (tie, shut, fasten).

k:騎.mnemonic: A strange (奇) sight in the ring: a rider standing upright on the back of a galloping horse (馬), arms out, never wobbling. Equestrian (riding on horses).
k:騎.hint: Rider standing on a galloping mount.

k:屯.mnemonic: A flat roof line, a tent pinned down at both sides, and a pole through the middle that bends at the bottom like a hooked tent peg. Troops sleep under it. Barracks (police station, camp, ton).
k:屯.hint: Pinned tent with a hooked pole.

k:憲.mnemonic: Under one roof (宀), on the nation's soil (土), hangs a net (罒) of rules that catches even the rulers, with the people's heart (心) at the bottom of it all. Constitution (law).
k:憲.hint: A net of rules over the nation.

k:純.mnemonic: Thread (糸) issued at the barracks (屯): plain, undyed, nothing blended in, because the army accepts only the real thing for its uniforms. Genuine (purity, innocence).

k:貨.mnemonic: A leader (亻) of porters counts crates of shellfish (貝) onto a ship, to be turned into money at the far port. The hold is packed to the hatches. Freight (goods, property, article).
k:貨.hint: Crates of shells loaded on a ship.

k:避.mnemonic: The people who reside (居) on this street cook food so spicy (辛) that the fumes sting your eyes, so you take another path (辶) and go around. Evade (avoid, avert, ward off).

k:己.mnemonic: A cobra (已) with its mouth left open at the top, coiled up and looking back along its own body. It sees only one thing in the world: itself. Self (oneself, own).
k:己.hint: Coiled snake eyeing its own body.

k:律.mnemonic: You stroll (彳) along with a brush (聿) in hand, painting one stroke on the fence at every step: step, stroke, step, stroke, a steady beat. Rhythm (law, regulation, control).

k:窓.mnemonic: A hole (穴) cut in the wall of your cocoon (厶) of a room. Your heart (心) lifts when light and air come through it. Window (pane).
k:窓.hint: Light through a hole in the wall.

k:吸.mnemonic: Lips reach out (及) to a straw as old as history (史): since the first reed in the first river, people have drawn their drink up this way. Suck (imbibe, inhale, sip).
k:吸.hint: Lips on an ancient reed straw.

k:恵.mnemonic: One (一) thing to think (思) about before you sleep: one kindness someone did for you today. Hold that single thought over your heart. Favor (blessing, grace, kindness).
k:恵.hint: One kind deed remembered at bedtime.
